name: round-context
title: DOE 轮次上下文 / Round Context
description: 展示当前 DOE Round boundary，包括 Round、Lot、Split Version 和 Wafer Count，用于 current-round analysis surfaces。

files.content:
import { z } from "zod"

export const RoundSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  product: z.string().optional(),
  lot: z.string(),
  splitVersion: z.string().optional(),
  waferCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
})

export type Round = z.infer<typeof RoundSchema>
